notes: This cannot see whether the provider tools are signed in or have quota left. A call that fails for either pauses the run and says so.
What the run's own inputs decide is checked when the run reaches them: the task class at START, and the data class G gives the project's files, which can keep a stage off the cloud.
A run waits at H1, R1 and R2 for your signed decision; that is by design, not a blocker.
